showListing.text: Events FAQ About Contact Sign in Alex Example Don't Be So Hard on Yourself About the Show "Don't Be So Hard on Yourself" is a cabaret concert of new songs written by Alex Example (featuring guest songwriters Jo Marchetti and Teddy Rowe) built around a simple but resonant idea: that we are often our own harshest critics, and that there is real power, and real humor, in learning to sing those harsh words and let them go. Example and a cast of stunning friends each bring their own voice and perspective to the intimate, funny, cathartic material. It's an hour spent in the company of people who are all figuring it out together. Featuring: Cole Bradenton Capri Castellane Jo Marchetti Jamila Sabare Teddy Rowe Genre New Artists Duration 75 minutes Age Restriction All ages 570 Example Avenue New York, NY 10036 View on map Show Disclaimer/Terms All Sales are Final. contacts.name: Alex Example
contacts.overrideBody: My name is Dan Wright and I'm a documentary photographer for the stage, here in NYC. I'm writing about your August 3 night at The Example Room. I work without flash and keep myself unobtrusive, so the audience stays with you and the performance isn't disturbed. Carnegie Hall has been my main room for nearly ten years, and I've also shot at Radio City Music Hall and Lincoln Center. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one hour minimum, and your edited gallery is delivered within two weeks. You can see recent work at danwrightphotography.com. I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for that night. I look forward to hearing from you.

draft.body: I'm Dan Wright, a photographer here in NYC whose work is entirely live performance. I'm writing about your August 3 show at The Example Room. I shoot without flash and stay unobtrusive, so the audience doesn't notice me and nothing on stage is disturbed. I've photographed at Carnegie Hall for nearly ten years, and my work has also taken me to Lincoln Center and Radio City Music Hall. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one hour minimum, and the edited gallery comes back within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com. I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the night. I look forward to hearing from you.
